description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Wind Ability Boost, Triplecast Wind, Unlimited Wind Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Wind Abilities, Wind Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Wind Abilities; Ends after using 8 Wind abilities
TP Max: AOE Wind/NE jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
One single piercing jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if at least 0/2 allies have En-Wind
WS Blue: [Dualcast Wind 3, Instant Wind 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user]
WS Gold: [Surging Power +30% for 6 turns to party]
